track: Yas Marina Circuit, Abu Dhabi - 2021 layout
source: Object_36 mesh (asphalt road network) in the GLB; main loop picked from the road graph
scale_note: calibrated so loop length = official 5281 m; model units are not guaranteed to be metres
axes: x,y ground plane, z up, metres, row 0 = origin, heading ~ +x on the straight
width_note: mesh-derived; stretch where the mesh was too narrow was interpolated
elevation_note: z relative to point 0, from raycast on the road mesh
